children: said on Tuesday its half-year gross written premiums rose 3% from a year ago in local currencies to 12.3 billion Swiss francs ($15.2 billion), helped by 7% growth in the Swiss market.

More than half of Switzerland's largest life insurance provider and major real estate owner's premiums, or the total payments collected from policyholders, came from its domestic market in the first six months of 2026.
